name: Verified native SAM2 bank cache for regional history training
status: Engineering/data capture only; no training or accuracy comparison
capacity_prerequisite: Run136 completion and independent final audit must pass; all inherited sources must match.
capture: Use the pinned author video predictor from each full video's original first-positive GT prompt, with no later GT prompts. Every post-prompt prediction must match archived Run118 hashes. Serialize only the native per-object output bank and full-video metadata using existing safe torch serialization. Do not serialize video images or duplicate current-frame vision features.
gate: On seq2/seq3 require identical tensor value/dtype/layout fingerprints after serialization, source/cache immutability, strict past-only training memories, intact persistent object identity, native low-resolution/object-score/intermediate-write replay, and actual four-layer frame/key/pointer schedules. Native and zero-adapter losses must exactly match Run136 before losses; trained diagnostic heads must exactly match Run136 after losses. Verify finite adapter gradients without an optimizer step and unchanged backbone. Diagnostic weights are never reused for accuracy training.
full_cache: Only after the gate passes, extend the same immutable cache to all 21 promptable sequences, reusing verified seq2/seq3 files. Exclude seq1/seq7 because no initial prompt is available. Save per-frame hash receipts and bank/index hashes. This collects missing training inputs, not a duplicate third-party accuracy benchmark.
causality: Cached banks may contain an entire native trajectory. Existing capture_training_read must filter every memory entry to frame < target before any training read. Current-frame cached masks/scores are replay references only. Recompute frozen image features from the original frame; GT supplies loss targets only. Preserve original full-video num_frames and pointer timing.
unchanged: No frame-quality selection, inference threshold, confidence gate, region-definition change, adapter change or hyperparameter tuning. CPU FP32 and native BF16 memory tensors. All artifacts remain on Drive.
scope: Exploratory PolypGen engineering. The cache-read helper preserves individual persistent IDs; this cache builder currently exercises the single-object PolypGen protocol, not a complete DAVIS/SA-V evaluator.
